start: Live workout or routine, a library exercise that has a demo clip (for example Bench Press)

steps.action: Tap the small exercise picture (its label reads 'Show how to do <name>')
user_sees: A sheet slides up with the exercise name as its heading and a Close button
must_not: Nothing happens on tap for an exercise that has a demo

steps.action: Wait for the clip
user_sees: A calm empty frame first, then the moving demo; screen readers hear 'Moving demo of <name>'
must_not: A broken-picture mark
The workout behind the sheet changing

steps.action: Read the numbered steps under the clip
user_sees: Steps 1, 2, 3 ... in grey text
must_not: The steps shown twice

steps.action: Tap Close (or the dark area above the sheet)
user_sees: The sheet closes, back on the same workout
must_not: The workout timer or entered sets reset

start: Exercise page of a library exercise (steps already printed on the page)

steps.action: Open the how-to sheet from the exercise page
user_sees: The sheet shows the picture alone
must_not: The steps printed both on the page and in the sheet

steps.action: Close it
user_sees: Back on the exercise page
must_not: The page scrolls back to the top or loses its tab

start: An exercise the member gave their own photo or video

steps.action: Tap its small picture
user_sees: The sheet shows the member's own video looping silently, or the own photo
must_not: The library clip or drawing shown instead of the member's own media
Sound playing

steps.action: Close the sheet
user_sees: Back where they were
must_not: The own video keeps playing in the background

start: A library exercise with only the older line drawing (no clip, no start/end pictures)

steps.action: Open its how-to sheet
user_sees: The drawing loops, with the drawing credit line and 'Credits' in orange under it
must_not: The drawing shown without its credit

steps.action: Tap 'Credits'
user_sees: The sheet closes first, then the Credits page opens
must_not: The Credits page opening hidden behind the sheet

start: A custom exercise the member created, with no photo, no catalogue entry and no steps

steps.action: Look at its small picture and tap it
user_sees: The picture is not a button (no demo to show), so nothing opens
must_not: An empty sheet opening
A crash

steps.action: If the sheet is opened anyway (an exercise with steps but no picture)
user_sees: 'No picture for this exercise yet. Here is how to do it:' then the steps; with no steps: 'No picture for this exercise yet. Add your own photo or video from the exercise page.'
must_not: A blank sheet with no words

start: Offline on the first visit to an exercise that has a clip

steps.action: Open the how-to sheet with the internet off
user_sees: After the download fails: the start/end pictures or the drawing (with credit) instead of the clip
must_not: An endless empty frame
A broken-picture mark

steps.action: Close and reopen it with the internet back on
user_sees: The moving demo now loads
must_not: The failure remembered for good so the clip never loads

start: Member's own photo was deleted from the phone after it was added to the exercise

steps.action: Open the exercise's small picture
user_sees: The thumbnail falls back to the library picture or the initial when the own photo file fails
must_not: A broken-picture mark kept on screen

steps.action: Replace the own photo with a new one
user_sees: The new photo shows at once
must_not: The old failed photo still remembered as broken

steps.action: Open the how-to sheet
user_sees: Demo clip loads from MettleUp's file store or the app bundle; the member's own media stays on the phone
must_not: The member's own photo or video sent anywhere
A third-party drawing shown without its licence credit
